lines.port: // A link standby asked for while a block was still going out (Rfu_SetLinkStandbyCallback, below). On the GBA a block is out within a few
// frames; over the internet it takes as many round trips as it has commands, and the standby was dropped: this console went on alone.
// A block still going out (the trade's START_TRADE, a READY_FINISH_TRADE...): the standby did nothing, IsLinkTaskFinished turned TRUE as
// soon as the block was out, and this console left the standby that the other one then waited in for ever (one console ran the trade's
// animation alone, the other stayed in the trade menu). The standby now starts as soon as the block is out (CallRfuFunc).
else if (gRfu.callback == HandleBlockSend || gRfu.callback == SendNextBlock || gRfu.callback == SendLastBlock)
return FALSE;   // a standby waits for the block in progress: the link task is not over
// The block asked for before the standby is out: the standby starts now, as it would have on the GBA.
// The messages to the other console that wait for the link (CtrTrade_SendLinkData, with the lower screen's trade code below).
// The leader's START_TRADE must be out before the standby takes the link: a standby started first would keep it from ever going out.
CtrLog_Write(CTR_LOG_GAME, "TRADE link got cmd=%04x arg=%u from=1 (leader)", gBlockRecvBuffer[1][0], gBlockRecvBuffer[1][1]);
CtrLog_Write(CTR_LOG_GAME, "TRADE link got cmd=%04x arg=%u from=0 (follower)", gBlockRecvBuffer[0][0], gBlockRecvBuffer[0][1]);
// The trade menu's messages to the other console (a choice, a YES, the leader's answers). The game sent each one once: SendBlock refuses a
// block while the link is still busy with the last one (on the GBA a matter of frames, over the internet of round trips) and the message
// was lost without a word, which left one console waiting for ever while the other went on. They wait here, in order, until the link takes
CtrLog_Write(CTR_LOG_GAME, "TRADE link sent cmd=%04x arg=%u mp=%u after=%u", sCtrTradeSend[sCtrTradeSendHead][0],
CtrLog_Write(CTR_LOG_GAME, "TRADE link busy cmd=%04x waited=%u frames", sCtrTradeSend[sCtrTradeSendHead][0], sCtrTradeSendWait);
CtrLog_Write(CTR_LOG_GAME, "TRADE link queue full, cmd=%04x dropped", data[0]);
CtrTrade_FlushLinkData();   // at once when the link is free, as the game did
// A debug block of numbers (Emerald removed it): R is free on the console, and a block that goes out takes the link for a moment,
// in which the player's real choice could not be sent.
CtrTrade_SendLinkData(sTradeMenu->linkData);   // a busy link dropped the YES: both waited for ever
if (!gPaletteFade.active && CTR_TRADE_SENT_ALL())   // the cancel the other console waits for goes out before the standby
CtrTrade_SendLinkData(sTradeMenu->linkData);   // the leader's SET_MONS_TO_TRADE, START_TRADE, cancels: kept until they go out
// READY_FINISH_TRADE had one try: with the link still busy it was never sent (the fallthrough below cleared it) and both consoles
// waited for ever after "Take good care of". It is tried each frame (CB2_WaitTradeComplete too) until the link takes it.
HandleLinkDataSend();   // this console's READY_FINISH_TRADE, until it is out
// The leader's word that both are done: sent when the link takes it (the statuses stay READY until then, so it is tried again).
